semantics.target_rule: Runner executes an explicit canonical operation/command/Routine target.
semantics.tracking_rule: Every active Runner has a runtime execution identity distinct from its canonical Runner definition.
semantics.bound_rule: Execution time/retry/concurrency limits follow explicit policy.
semantics.cleanup_rule: success/error/timeout/cancel all converge on cleanup semantics.
semantics.autostart_rule: Runner autostart is explicit configuration and ordered numerically when applicable.
semantics.osc_rule: OSC input boot semantics remain separate from ordinary Runner autostart ordering.
semantics.authority_rule: Runner existence/autostart does not bypass operation authority.

invariants.rule: Automation semantics remain explicit across Event, Trigger, Runner and Routine identities, and execution order never derives from incidental structure or serialization order.

OSC input boot conflated with Runner autostart

references.purpose: Runner terminal states use common cleanup semantics.
